title: Atlas DataFlow Capability Profile
description: Project Spec S0166. Versioned, architecture-level source of dataset-integration authoring artifact-role applicability for one analytical capability family. A capability profile is never dataset-specific: it must never be selected by dataset_slug, hardcoded dataset identity, filesystem existence, or a historical milestone id, and it must never contain dataset-specific feature names, concrete model hashes, model bytes, release-instance metadata, absolute external paths, or training-result values. `support_status` distinguishes a capability that Atlas currently, operationally supports end-to-end from a future architecture probe or a capability that requires further contract evolution before it can be called supported -- only `current_supported` may be treated as operational by any downstream consumer.

schema_version.description: Schema version for this capability profile document.

artifact_type.description: Explicit artifact type identifying this document as a capability profile.

capability_profile_id.description: Stable architecture-level capability family identifier, e.g. 'binary-predictive-classification'. Must never be a dataset slug, dataset name, or Telco-specific identity.

capability_profile_version.description: Profile version. Incremented whenever role applicability, semantic requirements, or capability policy change for this capability_profile_id.

support_status.description: Whether this capability is currently, operationally supported by Atlas end-to-end ('current_supported'), a documented architecture probe with no current implementation ('future_architecture_probe'), or a capability that needs further contract evolution before it can be supported ('requires_future_contract_evolution'). 'current_supported' is valid for a given capability profile only when downstream consumers (contract_derivation, assemble_candidate, and any release/publication surface) explicitly implement and validate that capability end-to-end; a capability profile document existing under this schema does not by itself make the capability operational.

semantic_requirements.description: Declares whether this capability's governed dataset-semantic-intent artifact may, must, or must not carry target/result semantics.

target_semantics_applicability.description: 'required' when a dataset-semantic-intent artifact governed by this profile must declare target semantics; 'forbidden' when it must omit target semantics entirely rather than populate dummy/null values; 'optional' when either is acceptable.

split_semantics_applicability.description: Optional. Whether a governed split/validation policy is required, optional, or forbidden for this capability.

artifact_roles.description: The complete, explicit set of artifact roles this capability profile governs, and whether each is required, optional, or forbidden. A role absent from this array is neither authorized nor forbidden by this profile.

role_name.description: Generic architecture-level artifact role name, e.g. 'discovery_evidence', 'model_artifact'. Must never be a dataset-specific feature name.

authoring_boundary_applicability.description: Optional authoring-boundary override of `applicability`, using the same required|optional|forbidden vocabulary. Consumed only by pre-materialization authoring-boundary validation; the global/downstream `applicability` field remains the canonical release-policy value and is unaffected by this override. A role that omits this field falls back to `applicability` for authoring-boundary validation, preserving legacy behavior exactly.

notes.description: Optional non-authoritative rationale for this role's applicability under this capability.

prediction_runtime.description: Typed declaration of whether this capability delivers runtime prediction, and how.

applicable.description: True when this capability delivers a runtime prediction/inference path.

mode.description: The current, evidenced runtime prediction mode for this capability, or 'none' when prediction_runtime.applicable is false. New modes require a new capability profile version, never a dataset-specific branch.

publication.description: Typed declaration of this capability's publication/public-surface applicability.

public_prediction_capability_applicabili.description: Whether a public prediction capability is required, optional, or forbidden for a release governed by this profile.

capability_policy_refs.description: Optional list of capability-specific policy references or typed policy values, distinct from dataset-specific semantic intent.

policy_value.description: Optional typed policy value scoped to policy_id. Must not embed dataset-specific feature names, model bytes, or absolute paths.

capability_boundary_confirmations.description: Explicit confirmation that this capability profile does not perform forbidden dataset-specific or release-instance coupling. All flags are required and fixed.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this capability profile document was generated/registered.
